runtime_context.note: Compatibility is entry-specific and can change quickly. Verify against the runtime used by your desktop client or profile.

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.install: npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.compatibility: README documents DSH Web and Node.js >= 20 / pnpm >= 10; verify the desktop-bundled runtime separately.
plugins.why: A broad workbench: file tree, editor, Markdown/HTML/PDF/Office viewers, browser, real terminal, Git panel, background tasks and extension APIs.
plugins.caution: Its built-in preview and terminal overlap with several standalone plugins; do not install duplicates without a reason.

plugins.name: dsh-attachments
plugins.compatibility: README documents DSH Web profile; 32 MB per-file RPC transfer cap.
plugins.why: Drag, paste or pick files into the composer; stages them under the workspace and injects references into the next request.
plugins.caution: Requires a workspace directory; pending unsent cards are held in host memory and disappear after a restart, while staged files remain on disk.

plugins.name: dsh-chat-import
plugins.why: Imports histories from Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini and other agents into resumable DSH sessions, with export/sync and portable bundles.
plugins.caution: It reads local transcript databases and files. Start with preview/dry-run and review paths before applying an import.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, supported-source table and compatibility section

plugins.name: dsh-session-search-pro
plugins.compatibility: Uses the host sessionQuery service; README documents DSH-only scope and a GitHub install plus patch launch path.
plugins.why: Searches current and past DSH sessions through the harness service, with a bounded scan fallback when FTS search is disabled.
plugins.caution: Not the right choice for cross-agent search; the author explicitly contrasts it with file-scanning session-search projects.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, comparison and stock-profile behavior sections

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.compatibility: CLI and plugin-shell modes; supports manifest/patch/build/pack/fresh-profile checks and profile diagnostics.
plugins.why: Turns plugin publishing from 'it built on my machine' into a repeatable preflight, including a fresh DSH_HOME install/config check.
plugins.caution: A passing preflight is not a security audit; source review and dependency review are still required.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, check matrix and CI section

plugins.name: dsh-agent-teams
plugins.compatibility: README documents DSH plugin installation and a pnpm build/verify path.
plugins.why: Creates durable sub-agents, dependency-aware tasks, direct messages and a live activity panel from one captain session.
plugins.caution: State is workspace-local and concurrent processes editing one team are not coordinated; treat it as a workflow layer, not a magic parallelism guarantee.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, install, architecture and boundaries sections

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-workshop
plugins.compatibility: README documents DSH Web, GitHub API/raw CDN usage and a package patch installation path.
plugins.why: A zero-server in-app browser for GitHub plugin search, trending windows, bilingual descriptions and installed-plugin management.
plugins.caution: It can install/update/uninstall third-party code. Review the detail page and prefer manual installation for unusual repositories.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, installation, architecture and security sections

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router
plugins.compatibility: README documents Node.js >= 22, DSH Web, optional Chrome/Tesseract/Ollama/LM Studio paths and desktop-profile caveats.
plugins.why: Adds image understanding and pixel-oriented tools while keeping the selected text model as the reasoning brain.
plugins.caution: Large surface area and external vision backends; anonymous free endpoints have rate limits, and desktop clients may ship a different DSH runtime.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, quick start, requirements, desktop and security sections

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.install: npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add github:hashdiana/dsh-token-usage
plugins.compatibility: README documents GitHub installation, built lib/ requirement and DSH Web UI slot integration.
plugins.why: Makes context occupancy, cache hit rate, input/output, throughput and TTFT easier to read in the composer.
plugins.caution: Usage projections and provider-reported counters are not the same as an official billing statement; keep financial records from an authoritative source.

plugins.name: dsh-skills
plugins.compatibility: README documents the DSH global skill scan root and Web settings panel.
plugins.why: Links or copies skills from Claude Code, project directories and .skill packages into a discoverable DSH library.
plugins.caution: Link mode edits the original source when a skill is edited; explain that boundary before using it on shared skill directories.
plugins.source_reviewed: README, identity modes, architecture and limitations sections
